LESSON: HOME ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL
Topic 1.3: Home ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Home ENVIRONMENT. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What work is done by a) name people found at relationship of people found at home people at home?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: HOME ENVIRONMENT
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES · Grade: PP1
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Home ENVIRONMENT helps you succeed in ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES. You will understand it, practise it, and use it in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

KEY FACTS: HOME ENVIRONMENT
Study Home ENVIRONMENT like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members. You will use ideas from in your school compound, home, farm, or county.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members.
2. Observe, explain, then apply using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Observe: Name what you can see/touch about “Home ENVIRONMENT” around your school.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Home ENVIRONMENT is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name what you can see/touch about “Home ENVIRONMENT” around your school. (skill: appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Home ENVIRONMENT to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members.
3. Make one local Kenya example of Home ENVIRONMENT from your county, market, farm, or school.
4. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Home ENVIRONMENT: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a PP1 learner study Home ENVIRONMENT?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What work is done by a) name people found at relationship of people found at home people at home?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Home ENVIRONMENT means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: appreciate the people • Learners model people at home at home for • Learners sing songs and recite harmonious living. poems about people found at home. • Learners could news tell about family members.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
